title: Word Counter
description: Count words, characters, and sentences in text, find the most frequent word, and generate text statistics.

steps.title: Count words
steps.description: Write a `countWords` function that counts the number of words in a string by splitting on spaces.
hints: Use str.split(' ') to split the text into words
Return the length of the resulting array

verification.successMessage: "Hello world" has 2 words, "The quick brown fox" has 4!
verification.failureMessage: countWords('Hello world') should be 2, countWords('The quick brown fox') should be 4.

steps.title: Count characters
steps.description: Write `countChars` functions: one that counts characters including spaces, and one that excludes them.
hints: str.length gives total characters including spaces
To count without spaces, split by space and join, then get length

verification.successMessage: "Hello world" has 11 characters with spaces, 10 without!

steps.title: Count sentences
steps.description: Write a `countSentences` function that counts the number of sentences by splitting on `.`, `!`, or `?`.
hints: Use a regex to split: /[.!?]+/ for JS
Filter out empty strings from the result
Return the length of the resulting array

steps.title: Most frequent word
steps.description: Write a `mostFrequentWord` function that finds the most common word in a string.
hints: Split into words, convert to lowercase
Use an object to count occurrences of each word
Track which word has the highest count

verification.successMessage: "the" is the most frequent word (appears 3 times)!
verification.failureMessage: mostFrequentWord should return 'the' which appears 3 times.

steps.title: Text statistics object
steps.description: Write a `getTextStats` function that returns an object with word count, char count, sentence count, and most frequent word.
hints: Combine all the functions you built
Return an object with properties for each statistic
Include: words, chars (with spaces), charsNoSpaces, sentences, mostFrequentWord

verification.successMessage: Complete text statistics with all metrics!
verification.failureMessage: The object should include words, chars, sentences, and most frequent word.
